title: Build an isolated inference-cache key
prompt: Build an isolated inference-cache key from tenant/access scope, explicit model revision, ordered messages/tools, and all effective sampling parameters. Canonicalize dictionary keys but preserve list order; reject NaN JSON values. Return SHA256. TTL storage and stochastic-request caching policy are outside this key-construction core.
